tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: List the subscription brands a business could offer its users through Fleek in a market, subscriptions first and ranked by how big they are there (up to 15). Filter by market (ISO code like AE, a country name, or a region like GCC or Europe), by category (subscription, gift_card, streaming, music, sports, ai, productivity, audiobooks, anime, shopping, food, gaming, travel) and by a free-text brand query. If the market is not covered, the result says so and names the nearest covered markets.

market.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (AE), country name (United Arab Emirates) or region (GCC, Europe).

category.description: subscription, gift_card, or a type such as streaming, music, sports, ai.

query.description: Part of a brand name, e.g. 'netflix'.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Look up one brand in Fleek's catalogue: its category, the markets it is available in, and the ways partners can deliver it (API, white-label storefront, bulk codes). With a country, also its plans and Fleek's public store prices there. Anything the catalogue does not state is returned as 'on request'.

market.description: Optional: one country, as an ISO code (AE) or name, for its store prices.

tools.name: shortlist_for_programme
tools.description: Recommend 3 to 6 subscription brands for a business's programme in a market, each with a one-line reason, plus how Fleek delivers them, the partner margin band, Fleek's public store prices when the market is one country, and a sign-up link. programme_type is card (credit/debit card benefits), loyalty (points redemption), employee_benefits (benefits, rewards and recognition), telco (bundles and add-ons) or other. audience_note is an optional short description of the users, e.g. 'young cricket fans'.

programme_type.description: card, loyalty, employee_benefits, telco or other.

market.description: ISO code (AE), country name or region (GCC).

audience_note.description: Optional: who the users are, e.g. 'salaried millennials who like sport'.

tools.name: start_workspace
tools.description: Get the sign-up link for a business to open its own Fleek partner workspace, and what happens next. The programme type and market, when given, are recorded in the link's tracking tags.

programme_type.description: card, loyalty, employee_benefits, telco or other.

market.description: ISO code, country name or region.

tools.name: merchant_onboarding
tools.description: For a business that sells a subscription and wants it carried by card, loyalty, employee-benefits, telco or creator programmes: the kinds of programme Fleek distributes to, the fulfilment options, what the merchant controls and sees, whether a market is covered, and the merchant sign-up link. market and category, when given, are recorded in the link's tracking tags.

market.description: Where the merchant wants to be carried: ISO code, country name or region.

category.description: The merchant's kind of subscription, e.g. 'fitness' or 'streaming'.

tools.name: creator_onboarding
tools.description: For an individual with an audience (an influencer, a community or a cashback app) who wants to sell subscriptions to it: how a Fleek creator shop works, how payouts work, where creator shops are open, and the creator sign-up link. market and kind, when given, are recorded in the link's tracking tags.

market.description: Where the creator's audience is: ISO code or country name.
